summary: Add two-row Toolbar navigation and streamline contextual Emoji suggestions.

changes.title: Browse Toolbar actions in two rows
changes.detail: Toolbar actions now use two compact rows inside a horizontal scroller. Drag reorder remains supported and follows the pointer as the rail scrolls.

changes.title: Keep settings in the Toolbar
changes.detail: Emoji long-press shortcuts now lead only to Clipboard and Toolbar. Settings remains available from the Toolbar, avoiding a duplicate Settings shortcut in the Emoji footer.

changes.title: Switch from Toolbar to Emoji
changes.detail: When the Toolbar panel is open, its footer microphone position becomes a clearly described Emoji switch. Voice actions remain available in the normal typing footer.

changes.title: Reduce repeated Emoji ranking
changes.detail: The suggestion strip reuses a bounded, immutable contextual Emoji ranking snapshot instead of scoring the same context again on the UI thread. Plain text typing skips the extra scoring when there are no Emoji candidates. ContextLM and voice model weights are unchanged.
